name: 22046 · Falls Church, VA
findings: ZIP 22046 (Falls Church) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22046 (Falls Church) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
